principle: These are conservative operational proxies, not validated one-to-one psychological measurements.

proxies.description: Fraction of exposed viewers who remain beyond an early-view threshold.
proxies.ambiguity: High hold can arise from salience, relevance, curiosity, autoplay/friction, or format constraints.

proxies.description: Fraction of starts that reach content completion.
proxies.ambiguity: Completion is multiply determined by length, pacing, platform behavior, and audience selection.
A profile visit indicates information seeking more directly than trust or connection.
Saving can reflect utility, deferred consumption, collection behavior, or platform-specific habits.
Share behavior is directly observed; its psychological motive is not.

proxies.description: Fraction of audience returning across periods.
proxies.ambiguity: Returning is an outcome and does not prove habit, trust, or parasocial attachment.

proxies.description: Repeated active engagement with the same creator across multiple exposures.
proxies.ambiguity: Repeated engagement is compatible with connection, habit, utility, controversy, or monitoring.

proxies.description: Normalized content-analysis score for self/group identity language in audience responses.
proxies.ambiguity: Only useful if the underlying coding/classifier has acceptable construct validity.

proxies.description: Normalized survey evidence for perceived credibility/trustworthiness/expertise.
proxies.ambiguity: Quality depends on scale validity, wording, sampling, and domain specificity.
